Millennial Software is a company focused on software development, automation, DevSecOps, and machine learning for security and defense. The company is seeking an Entry Level Full Stack Software Developer to design, develop, deploy, and support modern data-driven applications and tools for a Government customer. The role involves working across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure, testing, observability, and secure software development.

Responsibilities
Design, build, test, and ship full-stack features spanning user interfaces, backend services, and data layers
Collaborate with product and design to translate requirements into technical plans and iterative deliverables
Build and maintain scalable APIs and service integrations; ensure correctness, reliability, and performance
Implement and maintain frontend components with attention to usability, responsiveness, and accessibility
Deploy, upgrade and maintain software components into Kubernetes based infrastructures using helm charts and command line tools
Write automated tests and participate in code reviews to maintain quality and reduce defects
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues; participate in on-call or incident response as needed
Improve developer workflows (CI/CD, local dev, tooling) and system observability (logging, metrics, tracing)
Document solutions, decisions, and operational runbooks to support long-term maintainability
Follow secure development practices and contribute to risk reduction (security, privacy, compliance as applicable)

Required
Demonstrated experience delivering production software across both frontend and backend domains
Proficiency in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Python, Java, Go, C#, Node.js) and one modern frontend stack (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript with React/Vue/Angular)
Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST and/or GraphQL), integrating with databases, and handling data models
Experience with messaging and queuing platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar
Experience creating and maintaining Docker containers, Helm charts, orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes clusters, and using cloud infrastructure services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
Working knowledge of software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, debugging, performance, and secure coding
Experience collaborating in a team environment (code reviews, iterative delivery, clear communication)
Ability to break down ambiguous problems and deliver solutions with measurable outcomes
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience
Preferred
Experience with event-driven systems (queues/streams), caching, and distributed system patterns
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD best practices
Experience with observability tools (APM, structured logging, metrics, tracing)
Exposure to accessibility standards (WCAG) and frontend performance optimization
Prior work in regulated environments or systems requiring strong security/compliance considerations
